API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APISystem Audit ReportConfig Audit Resource Get Config Report
Config Audit Resource Get Config Report
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/configAudit

Retrieves the System Audit Report. To learn more, see About the System Audit Report.

Note: This endpoint is accessible via Zscaler OneAPI only.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
overallGrade
string

The rubric used to grade the report containing the overall grades for High Availability Configuration and User Performance Configuration combined.

Possible values: [A, B, C, NONE]

highAvailabilityGrade
string

The rubric used to grade the High Availability Configuration for GRE tunnels and PAC files

Possible values: [A, B, C, NONE]

userPerformanceGrade
string

The rubric used to grade the User Performance Configuration for authentication frequency and PAC file

Possible values: [A, B, C, NONE]

otherGrade
string

The rubric used to grade the Microsoft-Recommended Office 365 One Click Configuration and IP visibility

Possible values: [A, B, C, NONE]

greTunnelGrade
string

The rubric used to grade GRE tunnels

Possible values: [A, B, C, NONE]

pacFileGrade
string

The rubric used to grade PAC files

Possible values: [A, B, C, NONE]

authFrequency
object
authFrequencyGrade
string

The rubric used to grade the authentication frequency

Possible values: [A, B, C, NONE]

pacfileSizeGrade
string

The rubric used to grade the PAC file size

Possible values: [A, B, C, NONE]

office365Flag
boolean

Office 365 One Click flag

office365Grade
string

Office 365 One Click grade

Possible values: [A, B, C, NONE]

ipVisibilityGrade
string

The rubric used to grade IP visibility

Possible values: [A, B, C, NONE]

reportTimestamp
int64

Report timestamp

dataPresent
boolean

Data present flag

greTunnelRecommendedConfiguration
string

GRE tunnel recommended configuration

pacFileRecommendedConfiguration
string

PAC file recommended configuration

authFrequencyRecommendedConfiguration
string

Auth frequency recommended configuration

pacFileSizeRecommendedConfiguration
string

Pac file size recommended configuration

office365RecommendedConfiguration
string

Microsoft-recommended One Click Office 365 configuration

ipVisibilityRecommendedConfiguration
string

IP visibility recommended configuration
